QA REPORT · NDC-2806

CRM Global Sets: TAVI vs Zoho CRM

We compared TAVI CRM's Global Sets with Zoho CRM, listed what is missing, wrote a test spec and ran it on NDC-Staging. Nothing has been filed in Plane yet; the bugs and the gap ticket are drafts.

Run 11 Nov 2026TAVI staging-crm.taviportal.com, NDC-Staging, owner + CRM User accountZoho CRM test org org944965048 (Enterprise trial)Spec docs/crm-global-sets/spec-crm-global-sets.md

Bugs

B1High

A new pick list field can't use a global set

Steps

  1. Open the Leads › Standard layout editor.
  2. Drag in a Pick List field.
  3. Edit Properties › Advanced › Global set: choose "QA GS1111 Tier". The set's values appear.
  4. Click Save.

Expected

The field is created and linked to the set. Zoho does this (seen live), and NDC-2806 S4 asks for "linking new or existing picklists".

Actual

Error "Field '…': Option 'global_set_id' is not supported for datatype 'pick_list'." Nothing is saved. POST /modules/{id}/fields gives the same 400.

Workaround: create a local pick list, then Associate it with the set.

Spec rows: I1, J3

B2High

Replace leaves workflow rules on the old value

Steps

  1. Create a rule: criteria "Tier = Bronze", action "set Tier = Silver".
  2. Replace Bronze → Gold, then Silver → Gold.
  3. Open the rule; switch it on and create a lead with Tier = Gold.

Expected

The rule's criteria and actions follow the new value. Zoho's Replace covers "Records, Criteria, Workflow Actions, Field Dependency"; its field update changed to Gold live. NDC-2806 S3 says the change propagates to workflows and criteria.

Actual

Records move, but the rule still says "Bronze" and still sets "Silver", both now in Unused. The rule stops matching, and when it runs it writes "Silver" onto a new lead even though the set no longer offers it. Removing a value that a rule uses gives no warning either.

Spec rows: G3, G3b, G3c, K5b, F1

B3Medium

Replace is refused when a custom view filters on the value

Steps

  1. Create a Leads view that filters on Tier = Gold.
  2. Edit the set and Replace Gold → Silver Plus.

Expected

The view's filter changes to the new value and the view still shows the record (seen live in Zoho). NDC-2806 S3.

Actual

"Gold" is used by custom view filters. Change or remove it in those views first. The same block was seen in retest round 15 on 10 Nov.

Spec rows: G2, F7, E2E-1

B4Low

A save without the version number overwrites the set (possible bug)

Steps

  1. PUT /global-sets/{id} without row_version.

Expected

Refused, like a stale save (409).

Actual

200 and the set is overwritten. The screen always sends the version, so only API clients are exposed.

Spec rows: D8

B5Low

Two editor labels are not translated in Arabic

Steps

  1. Switch the language to العربية.
  2. Open Modules and Fields › Global Sets and edit a set.

Expected

Every label is in Arabic; the page is right-to-left.

Actual

The page is right-to-left and mostly translated, but "VALUES (2)" and "Move 0 to used values" stay in English.

Language was switched back to English after the check.

Spec rows: L4

What Zoho has that TAVI is missing

Managing values

  1. Replace doesn't update the places that use the valueNDC-2806 S3

    Zoho changes records, view and workflow criteria, field updates and field dependency. TAVI refuses, or skips workflows (B2, B3).

  2. No way to delete an unused value for goodConfirmed F5

    Zoho deletes from Unused, one at a time, and refuses a value still in use. TAVI has no route (all 404).

  3. Sort order preference isn't saved on the setNot in PRD

    Zoho: Entered / Alphabetical, followed by list views, reports and dashboards. TAVI: one-time "Sort A–Z" button.

  4. No predefined choicesNot in PRD

    Zoho's values menu has "Add Predefined Choices".

Sets Zoho ships

  1. No ready-made Source and Industry setsNot in PRD

    TAVI's Lead Source and Industry are separate local pick lists per module.

  2. No Countries and States list for address fieldsNot in PRD

    Zoho's list feeds every address Country/State field in 8 modules. TAVI country fields are free text.

Where a set is used

  1. Used In doesn't list reports, field dependency or blueprintsNDC-2806 S6

    TAVI says "Reports … are not listed here yet".

  2. No "which value is used where" viewConfirmed J7

    Zoho lists, for one value, the field updates and workflows that use it.

  3. List has no module names or Created By columnConfirmed J8

    Zoho shows module names as links plus Created By and Modified By. TAVI shows a field count.

Limits and API

  1. No limit on the number of setsConfirmed C15

    Zoho: 30 sets (Enterprise), 15 linked pick lists per module, 30 fields per set, 500 unused values. TAVI reached 51 sets with no refusal.

  2. No history of past replacesNot in PRD

    Zoho returns past replacements and runs a long replace as a job with a notification.

Not gaps: Zoho runs Replace in the background; Zoho Sandbox rules; TAVI lets multi-select and radio-button fields use a set, which Zoho does not. Zoho quirks not to copy: its API stores record values that aren't in the set, and its replace API returned 500.

Where Zoho CRM uses global sets

Fields in any module
One set linked to fields in Leads and Contacts at once; the list shows "Leads, Contacts".
Address Country / State
Built-in "Countries and States List" behind every address field in 8 modules, with codes and a Configure page.
Ready-made sets
Source and Industry ship as sets; Team Member Role and Access drive Team Selling.
Records
Rename shows the new label on every record; Replace moves records and updates their modified time.
View and workflow criteria
Rename and Replace change the criteria (seen on a view).
Workflow field updates
Replace changed a field update from Silver Plus to Gold (seen live).
Field dependency, reports, blueprint
Named in Zoho's Replace note and API docs; not checked live.

Not run, cleanup and next steps

Not run or blocked

  • Field dependency (J5): needs a set field on a shared layout plus dependency rules; not run.
  • Blueprint (J6): not set up for QA fields.
  • Low-user screen (A5): staging did not load the page within 150 s for the second session; API rows show 403.
  • Associate popup screen (I7): passed in round 15 (10 Nov) and by API today.
  • Round 2 (same day) ran list filter, mass update, import, Kanban summary, screen create, Arabic UI, keyboard use and layout Used In.

Cleanup

  • TAVI: all QA GS1111 sets, fields, records, the view and the rule deleted. Baseline diff clean. The Leads Standard layout held a QA field for a few minutes in round 2 (J3); it is gone again (layout v5, same fields as before).
  • Deleted QA records and fields are still in the TAVI Recycle Bin: the purge was refused by the permission check.
  • Zoho test org: workflow, field update, view, records, fields and sets deleted; records sit in Zoho's Recycle Bin.
  • QA RT15 data belongs to round 15 and was left alone.

Next steps

  • File the gap ticket (draft in docs/crm-global-sets/plane-draft) and B1–B5 with images, once assignee, state, priority, module and sprint are chosen.
  • After B1 is fixed, run field dependency and Used In for layouts.
